livingroom.title: Modern Luxury Living Room
livingroom.description:
A refined living space where elegance, comfort, and contemporary design come together in perfect harmony.

Soft neutral tones, sculptural furniture, elegant wall moldings, and warm golden lighting create a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere. Marble flooring, rich textures, and carefully selected decorative details add a touch of timeless luxury.

An open-plan living and dining area designed for relaxation, comfort, and modern living.

openplan.title: Modern Open-Concept Living & Kitchen Design
openplan.description:
A clean and elegant interior designed with a balance of modern minimalism and luxury comfort. This open-concept living space combines a sophisticated kitchen, cozy lounge area, and panoramic city views to create a calm yet premium atmosphere.

Soft neutral tones, warm lighting, marble textures, and contemporary furniture details bring harmony to every corner of the space.

living.title: Modern Luxury Living Room Design
living.description: A sophisticated open-concept living space featuring a cozy fireplace, elegant TV wall, and relaxing lounge area. Designed with soft neutral tones, natural textures, and refined lighting to create a timeless and welcoming atmosphere.

bedroom.title: Modern Luxury Master Bedroom
bedroom.description:
This interior focuses on balance — soft neutral colors, marble flooring, warm lighting and elegant modern details.

A calm and timeless space created through high-end 3D interior visualization.

house.title: Private House
house.description: A contemporary private residence combining warm wood siding, clean architectural lines, glass balconies, and expansive windows. Thoughtfully planned for everyday living with a spacious terrace, built-in garage, and a bright, comfortable layout.

kitchen.title: Cozy Kitchen
kitchen.description: A bright, spacious kitchen with soft grey cabinetry, warm brass accents, fluted marble backsplash, and a large island bathed in natural light. Designed for slow mornings and easy gatherings, with quiet elegance in every detail.

closet.title: Modern Walk-In Closet
closet.description:
A modern walk-in closet where functionality, thoughtful storage organization, and elegant design come together in one harmonious space.

Open shelving, spacious drawers, carefully arranged clothing, and integrated LED lighting create a practical and elegant storage solution.

Warm grey tones, minimalist metal frames, and herringbone wood flooring bring a sense of harmony, comfort, and sophistication to the space.

chalet.title: Mountain Chalet
chalet.description: A striking contemporary chalet perched on a snowy cliffside, blending warm timber cladding, dark metal roofing, and panoramic windows. Designed for effortless winter escapes with private terraces, outdoor hot tubs, and cozy mountain views.

luxbedroom.title: Modern Luxury Bedroom Design
luxbedroom.description:
This space combines soft neutral tones, natural stone textures, warm lighting, and refined details to create a relaxing atmosphere. The upholstered bed, integrated lighting, and carefully selected finishes bring balance between modern luxury and everyday comfort.

The result is a bedroom that feels both welcoming and elevated — a private retreat designed for rest and relaxation.

office.title: Home Office
office.description: A refined home office with textured geometric wall panels, brass accents, a sleek glass partition, and a cozy lounge sofa. Thoughtful storage, an ergonomic desk setup, and calm lighting come together for focused work and everyday comfort.

study.title: Modern Living & Study Space
study.description:
A multifunctional interior designed for work, relaxation, and everyday living.

A comfortable lounge area, functional workspace, custom storage, and warm lighting come together in one modern space.

about.heading: Hello, I'm Tatiana
about.text: I'm a 3D visualizer of interiors and exteriors. I turn plans, photos and references into realistic renders, so designers and architects can show a space before it is built. I have worked with interior designers and architects, so I understand the tasks and the specifics of their projects. I also draw floor plans in AutoCAD and ArchiCAD.
about.tools: 3ds Max, Corona Render, ArchiCAD, AutoCAD, Photoshop

sections.heading: Who I am
sections.text: This website is the portfolio of Tatiana Gurnak, a 3D visualizer of interiors and exteriors. In this policy “I” and “me” mean Tatiana Gurnak.

sections.heading: What this website collects
sections.text: Nothing. The website has no contact forms, accounts, analytics or advertising tools, and it does not set cookies. I do not collect or store personal data about visitors.

sections.heading: Hosting
sections.text: The website is delivered by a hosting provider. Like any web server, it may keep basic technical logs (such as IP address, browser type and time of the request) to keep the site secure and running. I do not use these logs to identify you.

sections.heading: When you contact me
sections.text: If you write to me on WhatsApp, Instagram or by email, I receive what you send, such as your name, your message and any plans or photos. I use it only to reply to you and to work on your project, and I do not sell it or share it with anyone else. These services have their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Links to other websites
sections.text: The site links to WhatsApp and Instagram. I am not responsible for how those services handle your data.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask me at any time to show, correct or delete the messages and files you have sent me.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.text: I may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.text: For any question about this policy, write to me using the contacts at the bottom of the page.
